name: string-length-counts-characters-not-utf16-units
why: The classic cross-language divergence, and the reason this category exists. JSON Schema counts Unicode characters; JavaScript's String.length counts UTF-16 code units, so a naive JS validator sees the treble-clef U+1D11E as length 2 and rejects it against maxLength 1. Python and Go count code points and accept. ajv special-cases this correctly - an SDK that reimplements the check by hand will not.
